title: Worker 40-byte record range transfer
summary: Copies a half-open range of 40-byte records in forward order, preserving the original grouped loads and stores, and returns the advanced destination.
test_description: Compare original and recovered code for empty, disjoint, unaligned, identical and overlapping ranges, checking complete buffers, return offsets and FS head restoration; also check null destination for one record and an empty null source range.
known_limits: The original custom ECX/EDX and caller-cleaned stack ABI is not directly expressible by the portable interface; the GCC test adapter restores its frame after calling the original.
Record field meanings are unknown. Invalid ranges, address wraparound, multi-record null destinations and faulting memory are not tested.
No byte matching or Windows binary-callable replacement is claimed.
